renderer_behavior.scope: Production component and candidate CSS, recreated CPU Chromium fixture; actual Load earlier and Jump to latest handlers, preserved thinking state, loaded-text search and append following. Native WebKit not measured.

serialization.scope: Actual old native JSON expression versus new production serializer on eight retained runtime-request-input snapshots, three pairs each. Serialization only; no model, storage, or context-compiler latency claim. Rust requested allocations only.

working_set.scope: WorkingSet extension and next-cache construction using eight retained request histories, three pairs. Baseline and production candidate preserve identical future reuse. Both sides make the same compiler-output copy; compiler work itself is excluded. No live-model latency claim.

limits: Historical CPU/Chromium fixture observations, not new measurements or whole-app/endurance claims. Native WebKit history performance and live token streaming were not separately measured. Fresh correctness checks cover serialization/hash fences, storage roundtrip/corruption and current session paths.
